## Pricing
Foundation repair costs in Austin: $3,500-$15,000 typical range
Minor crack repairs: $500-$2,000
Extensive pier work: $15,000-$25,000+

## Common Issues in Austin
Austin's expansive clay soil causes foundation problems. During dry periods, clay shrinks creating gaps. When it rains, soil expands and pushes against foundations. This cycle causes settling, cracking, and structural movement.

## Warranty
Lifetime transferable warranty on all pier and beam foundation repairs.

## Common Questions
- Most repairs take 1-3 days
- Insurance may cover sudden damage (plumbing leaks) but not gradual settling
- Licensed and insured Texas contractors
- Free inspections and quotes
- Financing available
